item.title: Injury escaped in overnight house fire in Manorcunningham
item.description: Injury was escaped after a house caught fire in Manorcunningham overnight. Gardaí and emergency services attended the scene at around 4:30 a.m. The blaze was brought under control, and the residents were safely evacuated. It’s understood that no foul play is suspected in the cause of the fire.
